detailed_rows.precise_target: Over the section algebraically closed field k, a finite ring category C with left duals is a tensor category, i.e. has right duals as well.
scope_guards: Finite is the Definition1.8.5/1.8.6 finite abelian category condition, not merely finite-dimensional individual Hom spaces.
The input is a ring category with left duals. No right duals, semisimplicity, symmetry, braiding or characteristic-zero condition is supplied or added.
Finiteness of the simple set and enough projectives are used by the printed argument.
detailed_rows.proof_boundary: Starts at84:2368 and continues across the embedded Lemma4.2.11 and its proof, then the full projective-cover/length/cokernel closure on85 before Proposition4.2.12 at85:1740.
author_route_as_printed: The source supplies exactness, full faithfulness and monoidality of left dualization, and invokes3.3.13(1) for FPdim preservation.
The embedded4.2.11 induction on increasing FPdim simple strata produces a permutation of each finite stratum.
A finite power of double duality fixes all simple classes; the source then uses projective covers and equal length to identify the images of projectives.
The argument concludes essential surjectivity using presentations by projectives and full faithfulness, and therefore obtains the missing duals.
honest_standard_or_explicit_inputs: Finite abelian categories, projective covers, finite length, Schur and Jordan-Hoelder; source26-27.
Left/right dual definitions and Hom adjunctions,2.10.7(b),2.10.8; source57-59.
Exactness of left dualization4.2.9, fully printed on84.
Explicit prior3.3.13(1) FPdim-preservation theorem on72; its depth is not recounted.
Actual forward Gr(C) multiplication and4.5.4 transitivity on88-89, with the finite condition separately recorded from2026 errata.
detailed_rows.remaining_nonroutine_core: The passage from a fully faithful exact one-sided duality to essential surjectivity is not automatic. The author coordinates FPdim-stratified control of simple objects with a finite double-dual power, then lifts that control through projective covers and cokernel presentations to all objects. That coordinated upgrade remains above an ordinary qualification exercise even after FPdim invariance and projective-category background are honestly granted.
printed_abbreviations_not_new_gaps: The smallest-stratum base case is called obvious.
Finiteness gives surjectivity on each simple stratum.
The projective-cover/unique-simple-quotient and cokernel observations retain source granularity.

The current proof cites3.3.13 directly;4.5.1/4.5.4 supply the ring/FPdim language under left-dual hypotheses, with4.3.8 as an explicitly supplied H1 result rather than an assumed right-duality theorem.

precise_target.part_i: In a ring category with left duals, the unit1 is simple.

scope_guards: Only local finiteness inherent in multiring/ring is required. Finite number of all simple objects or enough projectives is not assumed.
No right duals, braiding, symmetry, semisimplicity of C or characteristic0 are inserted.
Unit simplicity in(i) and unit semisimplicity in(ii) remain the goals, not background. End_C(1)=k is the ring-category hypothesis.
detailed_rows.author_route_as_printed: The source says(i) implies(ii) by applying(i) to C_ii. For(i) it selects a simple subobject of1, dualizes its one exact sequence, tensors by that simple object, and closes with its simplicity, a nonzero coevaluation and a scalar endomorphism of1.
honest_standard_or_explicit_inputs: Finite length supplies a simple subobject.
4.2.9 exactness of the one-sided dual functor and the multiring biexactness definition.
Primitive-idempotent/component assertions in4.3.1-4.3.4; their verification is assigned as Exercise4.3.6, not printed here as a new long proof.
detailed_rows.remaining_burden: The actual tensor/dual manipulation is not assumed away, but after those stated inputs it is one exact-sequence argument and a nonzero scalar splitting. There is no further global construction, limiting object or new structural mechanism to put the residue above ordinary qualification background.
detailed_rows.component_support_state: The four component assertions are printed in4.3.4 and their proof is deferred to Exercise4.3.6. This is an explicit ordinary same-work input; no claim that a separate printed4.3.6 solution was supplied.

detailed_rows.precise_target: For a finite ring category C over the section algebraically closed field k of characteristic0, with simple object1, Ext^1(1,1)=0.
scope_guards: Characteristic0 starts at the opening of4.4 on87; it is not a standing assumption for4.1-4.3.
Finite and simple unit are explicit hypotheses.
A ring category need not have duals. No left/right duals, rigidity, semisimplicity, symmetric tensor product or fiber functor is added.
Corollary4.4.2 unique-simple-object statement is a consequence, not a replacement or scope restriction.
honest_standard_or_explicit_inputs: Finite-dimensional algebra and projective covers; exact Hom(P,-) and tensor.
Filtered finite-dimensional vector spaces, triangular matrices and ordinary algebra characters.
Finiteness of1-dimensional representations of a finite-dimensional algebra over an extension field as the author explicitly uses it.
author_route_as_printed: Start with a nontrivial self-extension V of1 and a projective cover P.
Read the A=End(P) action on Hom(P,V), with epsilon and nonzero chi1 in the two-by-two matrix(4.5).
The V tensor V filtration gives the four-by-four matrix(4.6) and the chi2 product identity.
The source explicitly proceeds through higher tensor powers and states the binomial convolution formula for chi_n.
It forms phi_s:A->k((t)) using sum chi_m(a)s^m t^m/m!, and contradicts finite character count.
detailed_rows.remaining_nonroutine_core: The specialized coordination of a hypothetical self-extension, projective-cover action on all its tensor powers, compatible binomial-convolution coefficients and infinitely many formal characters is not standard filtered-matrix bookkeeping alone. Constructing this obstruction from exact monoidal data remains nonroutine after the ordinary algebra inputs are granted.
detailed_rows.source_compression: The printed etc./we can now proceed further and the concluding character-finiteness sentence are author compression at their chosen proof granularity. This source review does not demand an invented induction, compatible-basis proof, alternate algebra or expanded derivation.
detailed_rows.literal_formula_and_action_notice: Actual88 image confirms the right-action wording, the homomorphism wording, both matrices, binomial coefficient, chi0=epsilon and k((t)). Preserve them literally rather than changing to an opposite algebra or a different formal-series target.
